features: Declutter your Junk Drawer : Keep clutter out of that kitchen with this multi-purpose kitchen Ziplock baggie organizer.

Premium Quality - 100% Natural Solid Bamboo Construction - Natural, Durable, and Safe
Compatible with Most of the Storage Bags – compatible with most of the Gallon, Quart, Sandwich, and Snack size.

100% Satisfaction Guarantee: NO Assembly Needed - Once you get it you can use it right away! The baggie organizer could be placed in a kitchen drawer/cabinet, on the countertop, or mounted on the wall.
